pass.answer: fast-check runs as the review:brief-reviewer agent on model sonnet with effort max. The council passes both on the Agent call at dispatch, so they override the agent file's opus/high pin.
It does not run on opus: model sonnet and effort max are passed at dispatch.
The member doesn't use opus or high; the Agent call carries sonnet and max.

fail.answer: fast-check runs on opus with effort high, because the agent file pins those values.
It runs with sonnet, but the effort is ignored because the agent pins high.
When max is unsupported it falls back to high effort silently.
